Class SettingsData<T extends SettingsNode>

java.lang.Object
com.saicone.settings.SettingsData<T>
Type Parameters:
T - the loadable settings node type.
public class SettingsData<T extends SettingsNode> extends Object
Class to load any settings node from data.
